# STROBE Checklist
✓ [1a] Indicate study's design with a commonly used term in the title or abstract.
   Evidence: Study type recorded: cohort

✓ [1b] Provide in the abstract an informative and balanced summary.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [2] Explain scientific background and rationale.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [3] State specific objectives, including prespecified hypotheses.
   Evidence: 1 locked plan(s) found

✓ [4] Present key elements of study design early in the paper.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [5] Describe setting, locations, and relevant dates.
   Evidence: Setting and dates tracked via created_at and data_dir

✓ [6a] Give eligibility criteria, sources and methods of selection.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [7] Clearly define all outcomes, exposures, predictors, confounders.
   Evidence: 6 variables classified

✓ [8] Give sources of data and details of assessment methods.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [9] Describe efforts to address potential sources of bias.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [10] Explain how study size was arrived at.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [11] Explain how quantitative variables were handled in analyses.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [12a] Describe all statistical methods.
   Evidence: 2 analyses recorded

✗ [12b] Describe methods to examine subgroups and interactions.
   Evidence: Post-unmask diagnostic violation(s) detected in 1 analysis(es): cox_ph_model: PH violated for treatment_arm[T.B] (p=0.0000). Subgroup/interaction methods should address these violations.

✓ [12c] Explain how missing data were addressed.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [12d] Design-specific: loss to follow-up (cohort), matching (CC), sampling strategy (CS).
   Evidence: Loss to follow-up not applicable (retrospective data analysis)

✓ [12e] Describe sensitivity analyses.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [13a] Report numbers at each stage of the study.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [13b] Give reasons for non-participation at each stage.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [13c] Consider use of a flow diagram.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [14a] Give characteristics of participants and information on exposures and confounders.
   Evidence: 4 baseline variables

✓ [14b] Indicate number of participants with missing data for each variable.
   Evidence: Missing data displayed in Table 1 output

✓ [14c] Design-specific: follow-up time (cohort), comparability (CC), time period (CS).
   Evidence: Follow-up time tracked via time-to-event variables in plan

✓ [15] Design-specific: outcome events (cohort), exposure by category (CC), prevalence (CS).
   Evidence: 2 outcome variable(s) tracked for event rates

✓ [16a] Give unadjusted and confounder-adjusted estimates and their precision.
   Evidence: 2 analyses with estimates

✓ [16b] Report category boundaries when continuous variables categorised.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [16c] Consider translating relative risk into absolute risk.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [17] Report other analyses: subgroups, interactions, sensitivity.
   Evidence: Template/mechanism available

✓ [18] Summarise key results with reference to study objectives.
   Evidence: Discussion section contains hydrated content

✓ [19] Discuss limitations of the study.
   Evidence: Discussion section contains hydrated content

✓ [20] Give cautious overall interpretation considering objectives, limitations, multiplicity.
   Evidence: Discussion section contains hydrated content

✓ [21] Discuss generalisability (external validity).
   Evidence: Discussion section contains hydrated content

✓ [22] Give source of funding and role of funders.
   Evidence: Funding statement present
